2. **Removals and renames are breaking.** Any field removal or rename increments the
   schema `version` field. `scripts/migrate-config.mjs` must handle migration from
   `version N-1` to `version N`. Migration scripts are cumulative: `migrate-config.mjs`
   can migrate from any supported version to current.
normalized_decision: Field removal or rename increments schema version; scripts/migrate-config.mjs must handle migration from version N-1 to N; migrations are cumulative.
candidate_rule: Field removal or rename increments schema version; cumulative migration in scripts/migrate-config.mjs required
human_notes: Approved candidate boundary. Source: ADR-013 lines 19-22. Breaking schema changes require version bump and cumulative migration function in scripts/migrate-config.mjs. effective_date=null.
